tools.name: rh_token_rugcheck
tools.description: Rug check for a Robinhood Chain token before you buy (path parameter addr = token contract). Returns the LP ownership profile of each tracked Uniswap v4 pool for the token: the share of liquidity the creator or LP adder can pull (insiderShare), and the shares burned, held by launchpad or locker contracts, or held by other wallets, plus LP age and a class (held, safe, unknown, empty). Pools under 6 hours old are re-profiled on a rolling basis (about every 10 minutes; checkedAt per row). Tokens still on the Pons launchpad bonding curve answer class pons-curve with the curve, creator, fill progress, ETH in the curve, age and fees: a curve has no LP to pull until it graduates. Untracked tokens answer 404 and are not charged. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

addr.description: Robinhood Chain token contract address (0x + 40 hex)

tools.name: rh_bursts_live
tools.description: Robinhood Chain buyer bursts from the last 1-240 minutes, on every ETH-quoted Uniswap v4 and v3 pool created on the chain in the last 24 h. Each burst carries net ETH inflow, buy and sell swaps, scripted vs spread buying, pool age and a rug check (who held the pool's liquidity at the signal); outcomes are scored 30 minutes after the signal. Data rewritten every 20 s (<= 30 s behind the chain); data older than 120 s is refused with a 503 and not charged. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

tier.description: Burst tier (default main for live, all for history)

lp.description: Rug-check filter: safe = creator cannot pull the liquidity (burned, locker, launchpad or other wallets hold >= 50%); held = creator / LP adder holds >= 50%. Default all.

tools.name: rh_bursts_history
tools.description: Scored Robinhood Chain buyer bursts from the last 1-24 hours. Each row has its rug check and 30-minute outcome: return at 30 min, peak, the return under each exit rule (2% round-trip costs included) and whether the liquidity was pulled. Outcome fields are labels, not features (see /v1/fields). Data rewritten every 20 s (<= 30 s behind the chain); data older than 120 s is refused with a 503 and not charged. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

tier.description: Burst tier (default main for live, all for history)

lp.description: Rug-check filter: safe = creator cannot pull the liquidity (burned, locker, launchpad or other wallets hold >= 50%); held = creator / LP adder holds >= 50%. Default all.

tools.name: rh_pools_new
tools.description: ETH-quoted Uniswap v4 and v3 pools opened on Robinhood Chain in the last 1-24 hours, youngest first, with token, age, last price, ETH liquidity, last swap time, 60-minute net flow and the burst tiers that fired. Data rewritten every 20 s (<= 30 s behind the chain); data older than 120 s is refused with a 503 and not charged. Costs $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: rh_pool_flow
tools.description: One Robinhood Chain pool by Uniswap v4 pool id or v3 pool address (path parameter id, from /v1/rh/pools/new). Returns 1-minute buckets for the last 60 minutes (net ETH, buy ETH, sell ETH, buy and sell swap counts) and the pool's burst history. Untracked pools answer 404 and are not charged. Data rewritten every 20 s (<= 30 s behind the chain); data older than 120 s is refused with a 503 and not charged. Costs $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

id.description: Uniswap v4 pool id (bytes32 hex) or v3 pool address, from rh_pools_new

tools.name: rh_crews
tools.description: Repeat-buyer clusters on Robinhood Chain: wallets that bought inside 3 or more of the buyer bursts the scout has captured, with burst count and last-seen time. Use it to spot sniper crews before they dump on you. Data rewritten every 20 s (<= 30 s behind the chain); data older than 120 s is refused with a 503 and not charged. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

minBursts.description: Minimum bursts a wallet bought into, 3-50 (default 3)

tools.name: sol_bursts_live
tools.description: Solana pump.fun bonding-curve buyer bursts from the last 1-240 minutes, on pump.fun tokens 5 min to 4 h old that show curve progress. Each burst has SOL inflow, curve position, token age and, on sampled bursts, its anatomy (same-slot bundles, scripted sizes, top-3 share, top holders). Outcomes are scored at graduation or 20 minutes. Data rewritten every 20 s; data older than 120 s is refused with a 503 and not charged. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: sol_bursts_history
tools.description: Scored Solana pump.fun bonding-curve bursts from the last 1-24 hours: which graduated and how fast, the peak return, and the return under each exit rule with 2.5% round-trip costs. Data rewritten every 20 s; data older than 120 s is refused with a 503 and not charged. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: sol_wallet_leaders
tools.description: Top Solana copy-trade leaders ranked by shrunk replay EV. Each wallet's last 60 big pump.fun buys are replayed through one fixed copy exit (stop, take-profit, trail and time stop, fees in, capped at +100%), then shrunk toward the pooled mean so short records do not top the board. Includes sample size, win share and the leader's own sell pattern. On-chain addresses only, no names. Rebuilt hourly; refused (503, not charged) if older than 3 h. Costs $0.05 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: launch_snapshot
tools.description: Everything in one call, Robinhood Chain and Solana: live buyer bursts on both chains (last 1-240 minutes, all tiers), Robinhood pools opened in the last hour, and 24-hour tallies (bursts, scored, median 30-minute return, rug check, pump.fun graduations). Data rewritten every 20 s; data older than 120 s is refused with a 503 and not charged. Costs $0.03 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: rh_token_precall
tools.description: What a Robinhood Chain token did in the hour before a Telegram call on it was posted, for every call our desk saw in the last 48 h: buy swaps and ETH in the 10 minutes before the post, the run over the hour before (run60), the token's age at the call, the most buy txs in one block, and the pre-post buyers' wallets (on-chain addresses; distinct wallets and the most in one block). flags = the bot's own veto rules that match: run (>= 3x in the hour before), young (< 30 min old at the call), cluster (>= 5 wallets in one block). No chat names, callers or message text. Tokens with no call answer 404 and are not charged. Data rewritten every 30 s; refused (503, not charged) if older than 180 s. Research data from our own paper-trading desk, not trading advice. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

addr.description: Robinhood Chain token contract address (0x + 40 hex)

tools.name: rh_token_verdict
tools.description: One call before you buy a Robinhood Chain token: avoid, caution or ok, with every reason. Combines the rug check (who holds the Uniswap v4 liquidity, or the Pons bonding-curve fill), liquidity pulls after buyer bursts, the pre-call flags if the token was called (ran >= 3x before the post, same-block wallet cluster, < 30 min old), the token's age, and our desk's own last trade and shadow outcome on it. The rules are listed in every response. Untracked tokens answer 404 and are not charged. Rug check and pool data rewritten every 20 s, pre-call and desk data every 30 s; stale inputs are refused (503, not charged). Research data from our own paper-trading desk, not trading advice. Costs $0.03 USDC per call (x402).

addr.description: Robinhood Chain token contract address (0x + 40 hex)

tools.name: sol_token_verdict
tools.description: Everything our desk recorded on a Solana mint in the last 48 h: the safety gate result (with rugcheck.xyz numbers, attributed), scout scores (numbers), our grade from scanner-card fields, the trader's action and conviction, the shadow outcomes (return at 1/5/15/60 min, max favourable / adverse excursion) and our last closed paper trade. No trader thesis, no bot card text, no chat content. Mints the desk never saw answer 404 and are not charged. Data rewritten every 30 s; refused (503, not charged) if older than 180 s. Research data from our own paper-trading desk, not trading advice. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: scanner_grade
tools.description: Our grade (A-F) for a Solana or Robinhood Chain token from the holder structure on scanner-bot cards: holders, top-10 share, largest holder, snipers, bundles, dev holding, fresh wallets, curve progress, as numbers, with the penalties that set the grade. Derived fields only; the bots' cards are not reproduced. Covers tokens our desk scanned in the last 48 h; others answer 404 and are not charged. Data rewritten every 30 s; refused (503, not charged) if older than 180 s. Research data from our own paper-trading desk, not trading advice. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

mint.description: Solana mint or Robinhood token address

tools.name: sol_callers_leaderboard
tools.description: Telegram call-channel callers (Solana and Robinhood Chain calls) ranked by what happened after their own posts, traded or not: per caller n, hit15 (reached +15% within 60 min), win35 (+35% before -20%), x2, rug rate (-80% within 60 min) and median 1/5/15/60-minute returns and max moves, each shrunk toward the pooled value so a few lucky calls do not top the board. Callers are sha1 hashes; chats are named only when they are public channels/groups. Windows 24h, 7d, 30d. Rebuilt hourly; refused (503, not charged) if older than 3 h. Costs $0.05 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: sol_calls_outcomes
tools.description: Every human call from the followed Telegram chats (Solana and Robinhood Chain tokens) that is 1-48 hours old, with its return 1, 4, 12, 24 and 48 hours after the first post, the 48-hour high and when it came, the dip before the high, and whether the token died. Sampled every 10 minutes from our own series; no third-party prices passed through. Callers hashed, public chats only by name. Rebuilt hourly; refused (503, not charged) if older than 3 h. Costs $0.05 USDC per call (x402).

hours.description: Calls made in the last N hours, 1-48 (default 48)

tools.name: sol_calls_live
tools.description: Contract addresses (Solana and Robinhood Chain) posted in the followed Telegram call chats in the last 1-120 minutes: first seen, how many chats posted it, our own price and market cap at the first call (pump.fun curve or on-chain pool reads only), the move since and the max since, and its stage (curve band or pool age). Public channels are named with their @username; private chats appear only as counts. Data rewritten every 20 s; refused (503, not charged) if older than 120 s. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: sol_grads_live
tools.description: Solana pump.fun graduations from the last 1-240 minutes: time on the curve (gradMin), the curve path into graduation from our own curve reads, the buyer burst that preceded it when there was one, and returns 1, 5 and 15 minutes after graduation from our own sampled series. Data rewritten every 20 s; refused (503, not charged) if older than 120 s. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: sol_grads_history
tools.description: Solana pump.fun graduations from the last 1-48 hours with aggregates: median time on the curve, how many followed a buyer burst, and median post-graduation returns at 1, 5 and 15 minutes (with the share still up at 15). Data rewritten every 20 s; refused (503, not charged) if older than 120 s. Costs $0.02 USDC per call (x402).

tools.name: desk_trades
tools.description: The Paxie.Matrix desk's closed trades on Solana and Robinhood Chain since a time, for auditing its track record: book (main or explore), mode (paper = simulated fills on live prices, no real money), desk and lane, token, open and close times, return on cost with fees, peak gain and exit reason. Random-twin baseline desks are excluded. Aggregates are free at /v1/desk/stats. Data rewritten every 60 s; refused (503, not charged) if older than 10 min. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

since.description: Closed at or after: epoch ms or ISO 8601 (default 24 h ago)

tools.name: sol_wallet_copy_stats
tools.description: Every buy by one Solana copy-leader wallet that the desk observed in the last 14 days (newest 100): leader size, curve position, token age, other leaders on it, our quote drift and paper fill slip vs the leader, what the leader did next, the token's 60-minute path after the buy and the replayed copy return, plus a summary. On-chain addresses only. Rebuilt hourly; untracked wallets answer 404 and are not charged. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

Costs $0.50 USDC per pass (x402).
